description: This file defines the 'Session' struct and related constants, methods, and types for managing user session data in the Mattermost server, including session validation, copying, property management, and session type checks.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a user session with properties like ID, token, timestamps, user ID, device ID, roles, OAuth status, notification status, properties map, team memberships, and local flag.

classes.name: StringMap
classes.description: A map of string keys to string values used for session properties.

classes.name: MobileSessionMetadata
classes.description: Metadata related to mobile sessions, including version, platform, count, and notification disabled status.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of session fields suitable for auditing.

methods.name: IsUnrestricted
methods.description: Checks if the session is unrestricted (local mode).

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the session object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the session's ID, user ID, creation timestamp, and roles length.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the session for saving by generating IDs and timestamps.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Removes sensitive information like the token.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the session has expired based on the expiration timestamp.

methods.name: AddProp
methods.description: Adds a property key-value pair to the session.

methods.name: GetTeamByTeamId
methods.description: Retrieves a team member by team ID.

methods.name: IsMobileApp
methods.description: Determines if the session is from a mobile app.

methods.name: IsMobile
methods.description: Checks if the session is marked as mobile based on properties.

methods.name: IsSaml
methods.description: Checks if the session is a SAML login.

methods.name: IsOAuthUser
methods.description: Checks if the session is an OAuth user.

methods.name: IsBotUser
methods.description: Checks if the session belongs to a bot user.

methods.name: IsUserAccessToken
methods.description: Checks if the session is an access token.

methods.name: IsIntegration
methods.description: Determines if the session is an integration (bot, token, OAuth).

methods.name: IsSSOLogin
methods.description: Checks if the session is an SSO login.

methods.name: IsGuest
methods.description: Checks if the session is a guest session.

methods.name: GetUserRoles
methods.description: Returns the list of roles assigned to the user.

methods.name: GenerateCSRF
methods.description: Generates and adds a CSRF token to the session properties.

methods.name: GetCSRF
methods.description: Retrieves the CSRF token from session properties.

methods.name: CreateAt_
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp as float.

methods.name: ExpiresAt_
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp as float.

methods.name: LastActivityAt_
methods.description: Returns the last activity timestamp as float.
